description.value:
You gain Resistance to Fire and Acid damage.

You also gain the ability to defend yourself by momentarily assuming a watery form. As a Reaction when you are hit by an attack, you can reduce that damage by an amount equal to your sorcerer level plus your Charisma score, and then you can move up to 30 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You cannot use this feature again until you finish a Short or a Long Rest, or you use 3 sorcery points to use it again.
